objects.description: For [Operation Ghost](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0023), [APT29](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0016) used new strains of malware including [FatDuke](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0512), [MiniDuke](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0051), [RegDuke](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0511), and [PolyglotDuke](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0518).(Citation: ESET Dukes October 2019)
